hooks.command: jq -c '{t: (now | todate), run: ($ENV.V2B_RUN // "session"), session_id: (.session_id // null), prompt_id: (.prompt_id // null), prompt: (.prompt // null)}' >> /home/v2b-agent/use-log/prompt.jsonl || true

jq -c '{t: (now | todate), run: ($ENV.V2B_RUN // "session"), session_id: (.session_id // null), prompt_id: (.prompt_id // null), tool_use_id: (.tool_use_id // null), tool_name: (.tool_name // null), tool_input} + ((.tool_response | tojson) as $s | if ($s | length) <= 8192 then {tool_response} else {tool_response: $s[0:8192], truncated: true} end)' >> /home/v2b-agent/use-log/tool.jsonl || true

jq -c '{t: (now | todate), run: ($ENV.V2B_RUN // "session"), session_id: (.session_id // null), prompt_id: (.prompt_id // null), tool_use_id: (.tool_use_id // null), tool_name: (.tool_name // null), tool_input, error: (.error // null)}' >> /home/v2b-agent/use-log/tool.jsonl || true

jq -c '{t: (now | todate), run: ($ENV.V2B_RUN // "session"), session_id: (.session_id // null), prompt_id: (.prompt_id // null), cwd: (.cwd // null), transcript_path: (.transcript_path // null), last_assistant_message: (.last_assistant_message // null)}' >> /home/v2b-agent/use-log/stop.jsonl || true
